The actor wears a vibrant red saree from Roseroom by Isha Jajodia (@roseroomcouture) styled with a delicate pendant necklace from CLARA (@clara.in).

Creative Direction: Shara Ashraf Prayag Mishra (@sharaashraf)

Prachi Sapra (@_prachisapra_)
On-set Support Team: Ayushi Mishra (@styledbyayushi), Sameera Shaikh (@sam_wearable_art) 
Home Decor & Soft Furnishings: House of the Designery (@house_of_the_designery)
Plant Partner: Plant People (@plantpeople.in)
Location: Prestige Nautilus, Mumbai (@prestigeconstructions)
Artist Reputation Management: Communiqué Film PR (@communiquefilmpr) 

#dia #diamirza #diamirzafans #cover #covershoot".
